steps.content: As you dive deeper, the being beneath the Abyss finally takes notice of you.
The mountain-like corpse trembles as lifeless nerves and spines manipulate rotten flesh, its malevolence taking form. In an instant, a dark colossus obstructs your entire view, impeding your passage.
This is the response It offers to you, a tiny intruder.
Dazzling moonlight illuminates the darkness immemorial. Besides its gigantic body, the blue warning light you have been deliberately ignoring is shinning resiliently.
The spikes of your shackles surge forth in full force, crimson thorns cutting through the water as they thrust towards the colossus.
But the gap of power between you is still far too vast.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ugh...
The moment you touch the dark colossus, it feels like being slammed against a reef by a dense, viscous tide. One single round of confrontation is enough to nearly shatter your consciousness.
In a daze, you hear voices that should not exist.

steps.speaker: Dale
steps.content: Get away... Get away! Monster... Why me... I never wanted to die!
Countless agonized, wailing faces emerge on its body. Among them, you recognize some familiar faces.

steps.speaker: Ragnar
steps.content: No escape... Once you've come here... there's no leaving... It will find you... everyone will meet their end here...
A myriad of human despairs have been woven into this monster's form, as the being beneath the Abyss employs their faces to spread its horrifying malevolence to the world, and to you.
You cannot tolerate this desecration of your companions. Your rage briefly rallies your consciousness as you pour every last ounce of strength into raising the spikes of your shackles once more.
All faces flow as one, their features melting into black ooze, releasing a deafening shriek.
The shriek shatters every attack from your shackles as endless chaos floods into your empty vessel. At the next moment, darkness tears you into fragments.

You have lost. This is the Abyss's territory. The moment you regained a fraction of power, you walked right into its trap, your ignorant defiance earning nothing but its nonchalant glance. What's truly pathetic is that you couldn't even endure its mildest counterattack.

In the deep sea, darkness coalesces into contorted human silhouettes, encircling and gradually closing in on the lone, lingering crimson light. The foremost figure, carrying the most chaotic malevolence, drags numerous appendages crafted from dense darkness beneath its warped shape.

A mere touch would suffice to utterly obliterate your consciousness. However, for some inexplicable reason, the figure comes to a halt—like a dam teetering on the brink of collapse, restraining the tide of darkness behind it.

steps.speaker: Dark Figure
steps.content: Why... did you... come back...
You are long past the point of resistance. At this moment, any action is deprived of its meaning. Your only remaining option is to answer the dark figure's question.
Right... why? Why did you come back?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: For... Pylgia...

steps.speaker: Dark Figure
steps.content: Why?
The figure asks again as black tides wash over it repeatedly. You hear something breaking.

steps.speaker: Dark Figure
steps.content: She... doesn't need... salvation...

steps.speaker: Child's Reflection
steps.content: Heh... Heheh... Yeah, you're just so stubborn, arrogant, and full of yourself...
Indeed. "Salvation" is too presumptuous a word—nothing but illusory shackles forged for self-satisfaction.
Pylgia said she neither wanted pity nor wished to be a burden to her companions. So what did you come for?
Follow me. I'll take you back to where you belong.
Trust me one more time.
The crimson light flickers within the dark tide as your consciousness is peeled away, layer by layer. The last thorns protecting you crumble to dust.
In your consciousness, only one pure, blazing emotion remains burning—a feeling far less weighty than salvation, simpler than duty or mission.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just... want to see her one more time.
Suddenly, specks of white light appear in the dark tide. Their mere presence radiates warmth, constructing a solid dam that shields both you and the dark figure before you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I remember her face... her name... Pylgia... I want to see her.
The white light specks spread through the darkness, gradually unveiling the dark figure before you.

steps.speaker: Dark Figure
steps.content: Is this... really worth it...?
[Big CG 3]
The thick darkness peels away from her body, the coral shatters, and she breaks free from the monstrous shell. At last, that familiar face emerges before your eyes once more.
In truth, she yearned to see you all too. But she had lived as an outcast for too long, missing too many chances along the way.
Until this moment.
At last, she stops hesitating and running away. For the first time in her life, she is resolute in her choice.
She reaches out her hand amid the dazzling white light, and your silhouettes entwine. Together, you look up, gazing past the terrifying being of the Abyss towards the distant surface of the water.
This is her answer.
